PostToolUse.description: Warn when mock/stub/fake data patterns are written to source files
Warn when non-Supabase auth packages (NextAuth, JWT, passport) are imported
Warn when custom UI components are built from scratch instead of using HeroUI/shadcn
Warn when INSERT INTO statements appear in migration SQL files

hooks.prompt: Review the work done in this session against Tytos team standards. Check: (1) Did you use Supabase Auth and NOT NextAuth/custom JWT/passport? (2) Did you use HeroUI or shadcn components and NOT build custom Button/Card/Modal/Input/Select/Dialog/Table from scratch? (3) Did you propagate errors properly and NOT return mock/stub/fake data as fallbacks? (4) Did you keep seed data out of migration files? If any violations are found, output {"decision": "block", "reason": "description of violation"}. If all standards were followed or no relevant code was written, output {"decision": "approve"}.

Stop.description: LLM verification that Tytos standards were followed before stopping
